fields.name: creator
fields.type: CreatorProfile (nested: wawuId, fullName, handle, headline?, location?, verificationLevel, isPro?)

fields.name: fullAssetUrl
fields.type: string (URL) -- gated, must never be present for locked content

fields.name: courseLessons
fields.type: CourseLesson[] (nested: id, index, title, durationLabel, free)

filtersOrSort: scope=featured query param on GET /api/hub/content; mock layer filters mockContent to a fixed 3-id allowlist (cac-in-7-days, ankara-pattern-drafting, dry-season-poultry) -- server-side curation criteria for 'featured' is not specified in UI code
no client-side sort; server/mock order is render order
LandingContent.tsx additionally re-derives a 4-item desktop hero collage by indexing [0,1,2,0] into the same fetched list -- not a separate fetch or filter
reads.pagination: none -- fixed-size list rendered in a horizontally scrollable snap-carousel (CreatorCarousel) and reused for the desktop hero collage; no infinite scroll, no page controls, no 'load more'

uiStatesHandled.state: featured creators populated (carousel + desktop hero collage render)
uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: getFeaturedContent() resolves with items.length > 0 -- CreatorCarousel renders a ContentCard per item and LandingContent renders the xl-only 4-card hero collage since collage.length === 4 whenever toWatch.length > 0

uiStatesHandled.state: featured creators empty (carousel header with empty rail; desktop hero collage omitted; scroll dots hidden)
uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: getFeaturedContent() resolves with items.length === 0 -- collage becomes [] so the `collage.length === 4` check fails and the xl hero collage block does not render; CreatorCarousel's dot indicator is gated on `items.length > 1` so it also disappears
uiStatesHandled.reachable: no -- getFeaturedContent() wraps the real fetch in try/catch and falls back to a hardcoded mock filter that always returns exactly 3 items; there is no live '/api/hub/content?scope=featured' endpoint yet for this to legitimately return an empty array, so this branch is currently dead code in practice

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: user horizontally scrolls the CreatorCarousel rail; onScroll computes the nearest-centered card and updates the active dot -- pure client-side UI state, not backend-dependent
user clicks a FaqAccordion question row, toggling local `open` index state; first item (index 0) is expanded by default on load

uiStatesHandled.state: earnings calculator Standard vs Pro-tier toggle
uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: user clicks the 'Standard'/'Pro creator' segmented control in EarningsCalculator, switching the local `pro` boolean and recomputing keepPct (85% vs 90%) and monthly/yearly estimates from the fans/price sliders -- fully client-side, no backend read

uiStatesDesigned.state: single populated landing page (mobile, WAWU Landing Page.dc.html)
uiStatesDesigned.note: The design file defines one static frame: hero, populated 'Creators to watch' rail with 3 named ContentCards (state=free), fields grid, 'how you earn' cards, earnings calculator, services list, tier cards, testimonials, FAQ, CTA, newsletter, footer. No loading, error, or empty-state frame is defined for this screen.

uiStatesDesigned.state: single populated landing page (desktop, D2 in WAWU Desktop Shell.dc.html)
uiStatesDesigned.note: D2 'Landing page' is likewise one static 1440x2380 frame mirroring the same populated sections at desktop width. No alternate/empty/error frame variant exists for D2 either.
